mutation_preconditions.combination: A revision guard is required; all supplied revision/document guards must match
mutation_preconditions.expected_command_revision: Guards admitted commands, including other actors; live solver publication does not invalidate it
mutation_preconditions.expected_document_generation: Optional mutation context guard; prevents applying an old rendered action to a replacement document, including background publication
mutation_preconditions.expected_revision: Guards all state publication, including live samples

retry_retention: Latest 256 successful mutation keys per session; reconnect to the same process preserves them. Expired keys have no deduplication guarantee.

duty_percent.description: Quantity text strictly between 0 and 100 percent, optional %; instantaneous high phase has no finite rise/fall.

frequency_hz.description: Quantity text in Hz/kHz/mHz, bare text Hz; 0.05–500000 Hz before current sample-step and phase constraints. No sampling/playback adjustment is implicit.

preconditions: ID names a current pulse-source, even in an incomplete drawing

Preserves source voltage values, finite/sine definitions, sample step, playback speed and startup voltage

Re-entering displayed timing preserves phase bits and history; normal command/actor revisions may advance
Equivalent quantity/time aliases normalize before retry matching; snapshots expose configured timing, not measured oscillation
Never shortens sample step or changes playback to make a frequency fit; invalid requests preserve all prior state

errors.when: Malformed/missing/extra/null fields, both/neither timing forms, invalid quantity/range, wrong kind or shared phases too short for current sampling
Source ID does not exist after parameter validation

urn:elab:ideal-pulse-timing-input:1.x-source-inventory: snapshot.pulse_timings entries with shared true/source_kind pulse-source; all such entries share snapshot.transient_settings high_s/low_s
x-timing-relations: Exactly one frequency_hz or period_s plus duty_percent
Both phases 1 µs–10 s and >= current transient_settings.step_s
For fraction=duty_percent/100, frequency <= minimum(fraction,1-fraction)/step_s; other setting bounds remain authoritative

duty_percent.description: Quantity text strictly between 0 and 100 percent, optional % suffix; bare 25 means 25%. Rise belongs to the high phase and fall to the low phase.

frequency_hz.description: Quantity text: decimal/scientific Hz, kHz or mHz; bare text is Hz. Parsed inclusive range 0.05–1000 Hz, further constrained by phase/rise/fall limits.

Reapplying current displayed timing preserves waveform bits/history/physics, including reciprocal-rounding cases; ordinary successful command/actor revisions may advance
Equivalent quantity unit text normalizes before retry fingerprinting; frequency versus period alternatives remain different request forms
Allowed in atomic edit.batch; failure preserves the entire prior state

errors.when: Malformed/missing/extra/null fields, both/neither timing alternatives, invalid quantity/unit/range or derived phases failing retained transition/model limits
Source ID does not exist after parameter validation

urn:elab:pulse-timing-input:1.x-source-inventory: snapshot.pulse_timings entries with source_kind finite-pulse-source and shared false, independently of circuit completeness or accepted simulation
x-timing-relations: Exactly one frequency_hz or period_s plus duty_percent
Both derived phases 1 µs–10 s; period at least 1 ms
Existing rise_s <= derived high_s and fall_s <= derived low_s; transitions and levels are never shortened or rescaled

overlap_mm.description: Tiled overlap 0–20 mm; omitted/null defaults to 5 mm when tile is true. Nonzero overlap requires tile.

tile.description: Tile at explicit scale, up to 16 pages in row-major order. False retains single-page fit/clip refusal.

Each tile reserves an 18-point footer with page/grid/scale/overlap labels

PDF and print.submit include every page; multi-page PNG requires explicit zero-based page_index

urn:elab:time:1.description: Seconds as a finite number or decimal/scientific text; bare text is seconds; case-sensitive s/ms/us/µs/μs/ns/ps. Command bounds still apply.

urn:elab:waveform-quantity-Hz:1.description: Finite numeric value or decimal/scientific quantity text; bare text uses Hz. Model/coupled bounds apply after conversion. No hexadecimal, NaN, Inf or nonzero underflow.

urn:elab:waveform-quantity-V:1.description: Finite numeric value or decimal/scientific quantity text; bare text uses V. Model/coupled bounds apply after conversion. No hexadecimal, NaN, Inf or nonzero underflow.

urn:elab:waveform-quantity-deg:1.description: Finite numeric value or decimal/scientific quantity text; bare text uses deg. Model/coupled bounds apply after conversion. No hexadecimal, NaN, Inf or nonzero underflow.
